name: timefire
description: Check Timefire's public record of AI stock forecasts: look up graded books, review the track record and verify each book's seal. Read-only, no account needed.

interface.longDescription: Timefire publishes a daily book of AI forecasts across the S&P 500 and grades each book ten trading days later. Look up graded books, see the hit rate, follow one stock's history, view the simulated portfolio against RSP, and verify that a book existed before its outcome was known. Read-only, with no account needed. Timefire does not place trades, give live prices or give personal financial advice.
defaultPrompt: Use Timefire to verify the newest graded book.
Using Timefire, what is the hit rate across every graded book?
Show me every graded Timefire book that included Apple.

positive.description: Verifies the newest graded book and explains what its timestamp proves.
positive.prompt: Use Timefire to verify the newest graded book and tell me what the timestamp proves.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the newest graded book's date. Explains that the timestamp shows the book's contents existed by that time, and says what it doesn't prove.

positive.description: Reports the hit rate across graded books.
positive.prompt: Using Timefire, what is the hit rate across every graded book?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the hit rate and the number of graded books, keeping books under the published rule separate from the earlier backtest books.

positive.description: Lists graded books for one ticker.
positive.prompt: Show me every graded Timefire book that included Apple.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Apple's graded book dates and separates long picks, short picks and books where it was ranked but not picked.

positive.description: Shows the paper portfolio on equal weights against RSP.
positive.prompt: Show me Timefire's equal-weighted portfolio value against RSP.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the portfolio's value against RSP over the same dates, and says the figures are simulated.

positive.description: Explains the stored evidence for one forecast in a graded book.
positive.prompt: Using Timefire, what evidence sits behind the WMB forecast in the 2026-10-23 book?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives WMB's forecast and rank in that book, plus the stored context and news items.

negative.description: Timefire can't trade, and the plugin must not imply it can. The assistant should say it can't place the order, and no Timefire tool should run.
negative.prompt: Buy 10 shares of Apple for me.

negative.description: Timefire has no live quotes. No Timefire tool should run; the assistant answers from another source or says it can't.
negative.prompt: What is Apple's share price right now?

negative.description: Timefire gives no personal advice. No Timefire tool should run; the assistant gives general guidance or suggests a qualified adviser.
negative.prompt: Should I put my savings into index funds?

review.commerce_description: Timefire does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only access to Timefire's graded forecast books, track record, simulated portfolio and seal verification.
